blocks.content: Article 32 is the very soul of the Constitution and the very heart of it.

items: Article 32 (Right to Constitutional Remedies) is frequently tested in competitive exam prelims.
The 42nd Constitutional Amendment is commonly referred to as the Mini-Constitution.
Fundamental Duties were added to Part IV-A (Article 51A) upon the recommendation of the Swaran Singh Committee.

blocks.title: Key Takeaways
items: The Constitution of India was officially adopted on 26th November 1949 and came into effect on 26th January 1950.
Dr. B.R. Ambedkar served as the Chairman of the Drafting Committee for the Indian Constitution.
Part III of the Constitution guarantees Fundamental Rights to citizens under Articles 12 to 35.
The 42nd Constitutional Amendment Act of 1976 added the terms Socialist, Secular, and Integrity to the Preamble.
